Messages.Body:
I know it's been asked before, but I just can't seem to remember the
answer.

If a vampire plays a Cat's Guidance for +1 intercept and successfully
blocks, can it play another Cat's Guidance to untap immediately after
combat ends (assuming it is still ready)?

Thanks in advance.

Alex

Sent via Deja.com
http://www.deja.com/

Messages.Author: Chris Shorb
Messages.Body:
ahar...@my-deja.com wrote:
>
> I know it's been asked before, but I just can't seem to remember the
> answer.
>
> If a vampire plays a Cat's Guidance for +1 intercept and successfully
> blocks, can it play another Cat's Guidance to untap immediately after
> combat ends (assuming it is still ready)?

No, since both would be in reaction to the same action, and you can only
play one of the same reaction during any one action.
